fusions.name: Pilfered Pebble
fusions.desc: Hurls a snatched pebble that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up, and you heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Sleeve Flick
fusions.desc: Flicks a card that deals 4 damage, up to 2 times that at maximum range.

fusions.name: Palmed Card
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting, and slips you 3 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Fumbled Catch
fusions.desc: Once every 12 seconds, a blow that would have landed on you is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
